message.content: Halo! Saya belum memiliki informasi tentang produk atau konteks spesifik yang Anda maksud. Bisakah Anda memberi tahu saya nama produk atau kategori apa yang sedang Anda cari? Dengan begitu, saya dapat membantu memeriksa ketersediaan ukuran XS untuk Anda.

They might be asking about availability of size XS. We need to respond appropriately. There's no mention of needing to authenticate. So we can just answer. Probably we should ask clarifying question or provide info. But we don't have context. We could say "I am sorry, but I do not have enough information." Or maybe we can ask what product they refer to.
